security.detail: Both validateEdgeConditions() and isValidCelSyntax() confirmed pure functions. Verified by source code inspection of src/definition/graph.zig.

isValidCelSyntax_pure.evidence: Function docstring states 'Pure function: no allocations, no I/O.' Implementation verified: iterates over input slice only, uses only stack-local counters (paren_depth, bracket_depth, in_single_quote, in_double_quote, has_non_ws, i). No std.fs, std.net, std.posix, pg, or any I/O import used.

validateEdgeConditions_pure.evidence: Function docstring states 'Pure function: no I/O, no DB calls, no clock reads.' Implementation verified: accepts allocator + DefinitionGraph, uses stack arrays bounded by MAX_NODES/MAX_EDGES, calls only addViolation() (allocation only) and isValidCelSyntax() (stack-only). No SQL interpolation. No file or network calls.

no_sql_interpolation.evidence: validateEdgeConditions() constructs no SQL strings. All violation messages are human-readable text formatted with std.fmt.allocPrint — no database interaction.

graph_edge_is_default_field.detail: GraphEdge.is_default: bool = false confirmed present in src/definition/graph.zig. Docstring: 'When true, this edge is the default (fallback) route from an EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY. MUST NOT coexist with a non-null condition. At most one outgoing edge per EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY may be default.'
